notes.title: No Fail mode, better visual feedback and tons of sound improvements!
notes.content:
Here is the full list of changes!

New Features

 Better visual feedback when you poke a client
 No-Fail mode is now available if you can't beat the level. Gray level stars on board in the tent indicate that level finished in the "No-Fail" mode. After you finish a No-Fail level you will start the next one in default mode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36480292/0aaf0c95d041179d81c50faac2293ad1d2ce6dc4.png
The productivity bar close to clock indicates how close are you to failing.



Changes

 Reduced difficulty at the end of "Delta Hair Lines" level
 Changed Synesthetic Echo logo
 Changed time left piechart from red color to black


Sound improvements

 - Fixed missing boss poem (mathematician) for the "Hyper Birper Cube" level
 - Game Reset Button sound cue
 - Sound feedback when scissors touch heads
 - Sound feedback when Bosses regrow hair
 - Added Ghost Scissor Sounds
 - Music balancing
 - Mixing refinements (spatialized events)
 - Re-balanced Boss VO
 - Better snip sound


Bugfixes

  Fixed client jittering on left side

notes.title: 0.3.1b LIV update
notes.content:
For streamers:

- If you want to remove spectator info (Logo, high score, time, level name) on smoothed camera you can press "s" key to hide

If you are using LIV and trains are blocking your view use these keyboard shortcuts:

- Press "l" to hide left train and press the same key again to show train
- Press "r" to hide right train and press the same key again to show train

Other improvements and fixes:

- Tent and some other geometry is removed from LIV camera to make cleaner view
- Fix scissors angle when you are using Oculus with openvr (`-vrmode openvr`)
- Fix scissors angle on Vive Cosmos
